dhp337:6: While the word _bhañji_ normally carries the meaning “break,” the metaphor here of a stream-current repeatedly pushing down reeds seems to require a less destructive connotation.
dhp339:1: It is unclear exactly what the number 36 is referring to. It may be the six senses in the three times (past, present, future), felt as two feelings (pleasant, painful); or perhaps the six senses, both internal and external, felt as three feelings (pleasant, painful, neutral).
